"""Full-history raw-era scan: what raw FORMAT exists per year per station.

Decides (a) whether a re-rinex pass is worthwhile at all and (b) where the
era boundaries are, since the CLI re-rinex path pins a whole pass to R2 if
NetRS (.T00) appears anywhere in the range.
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter

ARCHIVE = Path("/mnt/rawgpsdata")
for s in sys.argv[1:]:
    print(f"=== {s} ===")
    for y in range(1999, 2027):
        raws = list(ARCHIVE.glob(f"{y}/*/{s}/15s_24hr/raw/*"))
        if not raws:
            continue
        c = Counter()
        for p in raws:
            n = p.name
            base = n[:-3] if n.endswith(".gz") else n
            ext = base.rsplit(".", 1)[-1] if "." in base else "?"
            c[ext] += 1
        print(f"  {y}: " + "  ".join(f"{k}({v})" for k, v in c.most_common(4)))
PY

import subprocess, time
